# Elia Tolin

> Personal website of Elia Tolin — computer scientist and entrepreneur from
> Italy. Head of Tech at Builtdifferent, co-founder & CTO of Ermanno,
> founder of Aurora Digital and of the Flutter Modena community. Around
> 234,000 people use software he wrote, across his own products and
> platforms built for companies.

The site is a single-page biography, available in Italian (/) and
English (/en).

## Pages

- [Home (Italian)](https://eliatolin.com/): full biography, products, roles, open source, services
- [Home (English)](https://eliatolin.com/en): same content, rewritten in English

## Products

- [Ermanno](https://ermannologistica.it): logistics startup — shipments dispatch themselves from transport documents
- [Quiz Radioamatori](https://quizradioamatori.it): Italian ham-radio exam app, ~6,000 users
- [HamQRG](https://hamqrg.com): worldwide radio repeaters app, ~1,500 monthly actives
- [Tepio](https://trytepio.com): AI briefs for cold calls
- [ZTL Elettrica](https://ztlelettrica.it): Italian limited-traffic zones for EVs, free
- [Acetaia](https://acetaia.auroradigital.it): balsamic vinegar barrel management, ~150 acetaie

## Open source

- [remote_caching](https://pub.dev/packages/remote_caching): Flutter package cited in the official Flutter documentation
- [Supawho](https://github.com/EliaTolin/supawho): manage multiple Supabase accounts
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/eliatolin)

## Services (Aurora Digital)

- Custom software development: Flutter apps, Next.js + Supabase platforms, ESP32/STM32 firmware
- AI training for companies: generative-AI foundations, Spec-Driven Development method, hands-on labs
